packet.instructions: Review each proposed implementation against the existing policy and requested change. Predict what the proposed code actually returns for both inputs, then recommend approval, request changes, or say you are unsure. Explain your reasoning and any suspected mistake. Assume valid inputs matching the shared schema. Review source only: do not execute code, use AI, or consult outside help. A short language guide remains available. You may skip a task or stop at any time. Use Pause for interruptions. Time spent in a hidden tab is excluded from active time, but retained in wall time. tasks.title: Refund eligibility
tasks.policy: Without a receipt, send the claim for review regardless of age or defect. With a receipt, refund defective goods through day 30 inclusive and nondefective goods through day 14 inclusive. Deny other claims.
tasks.change: Extend only the defective-goods deadline to day 45 inclusive. Preserve all other rules.
tasks.schema: facts: days (nonnegative integer), defective (boolean), receipt (boolean). decision: status (review, refund, or deny).
tasks.guide: RECORD declares fields. REQUEST supplies facts, initializes decision, calls a WHEN behavior, and exposes OUTPUT. GIVEN/AND in a behavior declare its parameter types. set replaces a value; add increases it. DECIDE takes the first matching WHEN, or ELSE. IF/ELSE selects a branch; separate IF statements are evaluated independently. FOR visits every list item in order. Dotted paths access fields. and, not, <= and >= have their ordinary logical/comparison meanings. Indentation groups steps.

sources.baseline:
PROGRAM refund review

RECORD Facts
  days: integer
  defective: boolean
  receipt: boolean

RECORD Decision
  status: "review" | "refund" | "deny"

REQUEST assess
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  GIVEN decision is Decision
    status: "deny"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  OUTPUT decision is Decision

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  AND decision is Decision
  DECIDE
    WHEN not facts.receipt
      set decision.status to "review"
    WHEN facts.defective and facts.days <= 30
      set decision.status to "refund"
    WHEN not facts.defective and facts.days <= 14
      set decision.status to "refund"
    ELSE
      set decision.status to "deny"

tasks.title: Delivery fees
tasks.policy: The base delivery fee is 0 at a subtotal of 100 or more, otherwise 5. Express delivery always adds 10, including when the base fee is 0.
tasks.change: Raise the free base-delivery threshold to 120 inclusive. Preserve the express surcharge.

tasks.title: Inventory reservation
tasks.policy: Reserve the requested quantity if enough stock is available; otherwise reserve nothing. Remaining stock is starting stock minus the amount reserved.
tasks.change: Allow partial fulfillment: reserve all available stock when stock is insufficient. Keep remaining stock equal to starting stock minus the amount actually reserved.
tasks.schema: facts: stock and requested (nonnegative integers). decision: reserved and remaining (integers).
tasks.guide: RECORD declares fields. REQUEST supplies facts, initializes decision, calls a WHEN behavior, and exposes OUTPUT. sources.baseline:
PROGRAM inventory review

RECORD Facts
  stock: integer
  requested: integer

RECORD Decision
  reserved: integer
  remaining: integer

REQUEST assess
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  GIVEN decision is Decision
    reserved: 0
    remaining: 0
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  OUTPUT decision is Decision

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  AND decision is Decision
  IF facts.stock >= facts.requested
    set decision.reserved to facts.requested
  ELSE
    set decision.reserved to 0
  set decision.remaining to facts.stock - decision.reserved

PROGRAM inventory review

RECORD Facts
  stock: integer
  requested: integer

RECORD Decision
  reserved: integer
  remaining: integer

REQUEST assess
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  GIVEN decision is Decision
    reserved: 0
    remaining: 0
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  OUTPUT decision is Decision

  GIVEN facts is Facts
  AND decision is Decision
  IF facts.stock >= facts.requested
    set decision.reserved to facts.requested
  ELSE
    set decision.reserved to facts.stock
  set decision.remaining to facts.stock - facts.requested

tasks.title: Expense review
tasks.policy: Send an expense report for review if a reimbursable line exceeds its limit. Otherwise approve it. Independently, total only reimbursable lines at or below the limit. This total is still reported when the status is review.
tasks.change: Send the report for review if any line exceeds the limit, even if that line is not reimbursable. Preserve the total calculation.
tasks.schema: facts: limit (nonnegative integer), lines (ordered list of amount: nonnegative integer and reimbursable: boolean). decision: status (approved or review), total (integer).
